facts.fact: Jordan 死状确认：从卧室阳台坠落，被玫瑰园铁栅的尖头刺穿腹部——园丁清晨发现。
facts.anchor: her body was impaled on the iron fence surrounding the beds of roses around the Victorian house.

facts.fact: 死人挡不住同学会：活动照办，女士午宴当天下午就在 Jordan 摔死的地方开席。
facts.anchor: One dead body isn’t enough to derail a week this town’s been planning for months.

facts.fact: Cathie 劝她回家，Max 拒绝——缪斯刚回来，一夜三章，她要「看完这场戏」。
facts.anchor: I still can’t believe that I wrote a whopping three chapters.

facts.fact: Sienna 饭后要去找警长 Eli：法医到底怎么定性——意外还是有别的。
facts.anchor: I want to know if he thinks this was an accidental death

facts.fact: Sienna 排除自杀：Jordan 爱自己爱得要死，不会跳——更像「被人推下去」。
动机分析：当年结下旧账的人，借同学会这个「完美时机」来清账——这名单很长，她和 Max 排不进前五。
facts.anchor: Maybe someone from back in the day had an old score to settle

facts.fact: 关键自白：昨晚与 Jordan 争执的正是 Max——键盘声+音乐吵到她，对方来砸门、她摔门。
facts.anchor: That was me. I was the one arguing with Jordan.

facts.fact: 物理疑点：失足坠落应近乎垂直，Jordan 却落在足够远处、正好砸中玫瑰园铁栅——「物理上说不通」。
facts.anchor: If Jordan simply slipped over that balcony, the most likely scenario is that she would’ve fallen almost straight down.

facts.fact: 结论落锤：我们中间可能有个凶手；Sienna 露出多年来第一个真心的笑。
facts.anchor: That we might have a murderer in our midst?
